% Epistemic status tags ([K], [C], [A], [O]) — consistent monospace rendering.
\newcommand{\statustag}[1]{\texttt{[#1]}}
\newcommand{\statustagpair}[2]{\texttt{[#1+#2]}}

% Map Unicode glyphs missing from Latin Modern (XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX on arXiv).
\usepackage{newunicodechar}
\newunicodechar{♭}{\ensuremath{\flat}}
\newunicodechar{⇒}{\ensuremath{\Rightarrow}}
\newunicodechar{⊓}{\ensuremath{\sqcap}}
\newunicodechar{⊔}{\ensuremath{\sqcup}}
\newunicodechar{≤}{\ensuremath{\leq}}
\newunicodechar{≥}{\ensuremath{\geq}}
\newunicodechar{↔}{\ensuremath{\leftrightarrow}}
\newunicodechar{δ}{\ensuremath{\delta}}
\newunicodechar{ι}{\ensuremath{\iota}}
\newunicodechar{χ}{\ensuremath{\chi}}
\newunicodechar{Σ}{\ensuremath{\Sigma}}
\newunicodechar{Δ}{\ensuremath{\Delta}}
